criteria.text: a session created directly in agent_sessions with owner_user_id=A, project_id=P, no claim-table row → IS visible to caller A in project P via the mobile gateway's session-list shaping path
criteria.test_id: issue-1279-c1: a desktop-owned session without a claim is visible to its owner in its project

criteria.text: that same session is NOT visible to caller B (different owner_user_id) even in the same project
criteria.test_id: issue-1279-c2: desktop ownership fallback rejects another user in the same project

criteria.test_id: issue-1279-c3: desktop ownership fallback rejects the owner in another project

criteria.text: In resourceOwnedByCaller, treat a resource as owned if EITHER the explicit claim table says so (current behavior, keep it) OR the new desktop-ownership fallback says so.
criteria.test_id: issue-1279-c4: explicit session claims remain visible

criteria.text: Do NOT relax isResourceExplicitlyOwnedBy — reconcileCatalogSession's use of it should still mean "has an explicit claim," since it's writing back metadata, not just reading visibility.
criteria.test_id: issue-1279-c5: desktop catalog ownership does not become an explicit claim

criteria.text: This only applies to kind === 'session' — ptys have no desktop-side ownership record to fall back to, leave pty ownership exactly as-is.
